known_outcome: Holmes rejected this commit: tests/unit/portfolio-report.test.sh uses a whole-file assert_present 'portfolio-rollup.js' for a section-3 claim, and the string also appears in the file's intro, so the assertion passes vacuously.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `commands/ynab-portfolio.md` slash command exists, is syntactically valid, and is reachable via Claude's slash-command picker
- [ ] The skill reads the M6-6 budgets config to discover which budgets are enabled and their assigned roles/tags (e.g. `business`); no budget IDs are hard-coded
- [ ] Per-budget data is fetched via namespaced `mcp__plugin_workbench-ynab_ynab__*` tools scoped by `budget_id`; where M6-6 cached per-budget fragments are available they are consumed instead of re-fetching
- [ ] Aggregated output includes all four summary dimensions: combined account balances / net worth, aggregate income vs spending, cross-budget Ready-to-Assign, and a unified health score
- [ ] All milliunit amounts are converted to the display currency before aggregation; no raw-milliunit values are summed across budgets
- [ ] Schedule C activity is aggregated across all `business`-tagged budgets and the result is fed into the M6-4 quarterly-tax tracker to produce a single YTD tax picture (not per-budget fragments)
- [ ] The report renders into the frozen v1 HTML template reusing its fragment-fill approach; dark-theme tokens (#1a1a2e / #16a085 / #e74c3c / #f39c12), a KPI dashboard section, and collapsible per-budget detail sections are present
- [ ] The `@media print` block from the frozen template is inherited by the rollup report; the missing-print-CSS bug from the prototype does not recur (verified by inspecting rendered HTML)
- [ ] Dispatch summary output is severity-prefixed with findings ordered most-severe first, spanning all budgets
- [ ] The rollup is strictly read-only: no budget data, category, or transaction is modified at any point during execution
